Compressed creature model decoders (solMaxima 0.66.0), copied unchanged from three.js r180 examples/jsm except for
import paths pointing to ../three.module.min.js:

- loaders/KTX2Loader.js, utils/WorkerPool.js, math/ColorSpaces.js: three.js, MIT License (see THREE-LICENSE.txt).
- libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js: meshoptimizer, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2016-2025 Arseny Kapoulkine.
- libs/ktx-parse.module.js: ktx-parse, MIT License, Copyright (c) Don McCurdy.
- libs/zstddec.module.js: zstddec, MIT License, Copyright (c) Don McCurdy; includes zstd (BSD License, Meta Platforms).
- libs/basis/basis_transcoder.js and .wasm: Basis Universal transcoder, Apache License 2.0, Copyright (c) Binomial LLC.
